reason: The agent's own notice 'You've hit your monthly spend limit.' with '/usage-credits to adjust your monthly spend limit.' ends the turn ('Cogitated for 0s'), with the task list still open and the composer empty. A monthly spend limit is an allowance that is used up, which is what the allowance rule watches for; no reset time is stated, so the wait is bounded by the rule's ceilings.
factsNote: The agent is read off the screen's own chrome (the bypass-permissions bar and the turn summary line are this agent's). The activity state is WaitingForInput because a turn-brief package is built when a turn ends, which is the moment the session goes idle. Machine, repository and mission are not recorded in the package, so they are left empty.
